name: GitHub Copilot code review
tagline: Pull request review bundled into paid GitHub Copilot plans; reviews the diff with instructions-file customization, metered by AI credits.
pricing: Included from Copilot Pro $10/mo ($15 AI credits), Pro+ $39 ($70), Max $100 ($200); Business $19 and Enterprise $39/user/mo; metered AI credits since June 1, 2026 plus Actions minutes
selfHostedNote: Cloud service; agentic checks can run on self-hosted Actions runners (ARC, Ubuntu x64), but that is compute placement, not self-hosting.
modelControl: No model choice; GitHub-managed models with Lite/Balanced review effort levels

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Reviews the diff plus instructions files, not the codebase - shallowest context in our comparison.

02-rule-centric.note: Repo instructions (copilot-instructions.md, AGENTS.md, path-scoped files) give basic standards control.

03-dual-workflow.note: Copilot spans IDE assistance and PR review, but the review product itself is PR-only.

04-business-logic.note: No ticket or requirements validation documented.

05-continuous-learning.note: No learning loop documented; re-reviews can repeat previously dismissed comments.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Agentic architecture (Mar 2026) runs validation steps on Actions runners; validation scope unclear.

07-economic-transparency.note: No model choice or BYOK; metered AI credits at model token rates plus Actions minutes.

08-actionability.note: Suggested fixes can be applied via the Copilot coding agent; otherwise comment-only, no follow-up replies.

09-measurable-roi.note: No review ROI metrics documented; spend visible only through AI credit consumption.
